questions.instructions: `heading` is a section heading repeated across several CLAUDE.md files. `copies` says how many files carry it and how many distinct variants of its body exist, and `variants` holds the variant bodies. Which cause best explains why the copies differ?

criteria.names_project: the section embeds the package or repo name, so each copy is about its own project
criteria.whitespace_only: the copies differ only in whitespace or line wrapping
criteria.substantive_drift: the copies differ in substance: the same guidance drifted apart
criteria.pointer_only: the copies share only a closing pointer sentence; each body is unique
criteria.all_unique: every copy is unique; nothing is shared
criteria.none: none of these explains the difference
